An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''governor''' was installed to administer the [[Pacanth Reach/Legends|Pacanth Reach]] shortly after [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Declaration of a New Order]]. The [[Governor/Legends|governor]] worked with the native [[Epicanthix]] people to develop the local economy, allowing them a certain degree of autonomy.
